verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document Render alerts that notify a user by chat or email when conditions are met. The closest items are adjacent: workspace webhooks notify other systems on service events, and telemetry can be streamed to external tools. Routing those to chat or email would be a user-side workaround, not Render's own alerting feature.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can set up alerts that notify me via chat or email when specific conditions are met
